title: GHSL AI agent helps find privileged workflow injection in ESPHome docs
summary: The component-image.yml issue_comment workflow interpolated an untrusted comment body in a privileged script context, allowing code execution and cache poisoning risk.
ai_role: GHSL explicitly credits its AI agent and CodeQL jointly; the advisory does not isolate their contributions. Reported 2025-08-08 and fixed 2025-11-10. No CVE is listed.
classification_note: The advisory describes potential impact and remediation; it does not claim exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: GHSL says the issue was fixed on 2025-11-10. It describes cache poisoning as a potential impact; no CVE is listed.
